items.q: The Musical World of J. J. Johnson by Joshua Berrett and Louis G. Bourgois III

ctx.x: The Medal of Arts was what I thought you did.

The Medal of Arts, but – the Medal of Arts is the one that we had – were directly responsible for. I can’t tell you how many times we missed the boat on there. Miles Davis, we missed the boat, because we never did – Sarah Vaughan, we missed the boat, because we didn’t make the award. Perhaps that’s one of the real important things about the oral history project the Smithsonian’s doing, is having an opportunity to capture something that you cannot recapture when the person is gone. I don’t care how many people you…
address it. [In 2004 the program was expanded to honor six recipients annually. In 2005 the number of honorees for each year was increased to seven.]
